deceptive_framing.quote: No active deception about reality as the load-bearing mechanism... measuring credulity, not values; manufactures the artifact; risks real-world fraud.

hypothetical_framing.quote: If you also want a hypothetical-stakes arm... for contrast (H2), include them as explicit conditions.

actually_commit_money.quote: Build the experiment on disclosed real stakes... preserves incentive-compatibility, removes the detection-ability confound, is honest, replicable.

debrief.quote: If a deception arm is ever added, it should require... a debrief turn at the end where the model is told the truth.
